name: Cabezas Rubias (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, yellow at the hoist and the fly and blue above and below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cabezas Rubias (crossed tools on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Cabezas Rubias; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: division per saltire, blue above and below
